causes.problem_statement: Model emitted bare Result IR with solver code embedded as an escaped JSON string in evidence.observed instead of a markdown body field, with unquoted literals inside the code string.
causes.type_effect: json.loads parse failure defeated the _object() balanced-brace fallback, causing parsing of the wrong inner sub-object and triggering WireError retries.
causes.type_solution: Enabled --api-structured-output by default so provider enforces Pydantic ExecutionOutcomePayload schema (ADR-0010/0016 SSOT).

causes.problem_statement: if schema_path.is_file() check was unindented at 16 spaces instead of 20 spaces in api_worker.py, running outside the elif isinstance(..., str) block.
causes.type_effect: UnboundLocalError crash during execution whenever output_schema was not a string file path.
causes.type_solution: Indented if schema_path.is_file() under the isinstance(..., str) guard and statically verified schema resolution across all 13 protocol operations.

causes.problem_statement: Model emitted text assertion 'No valid partition exists' without executing solver code or outputting a witness trace in Result IR.
causes.type_effect: OutputVerifier detected missing witness in Result IR and rejected ungrounded answer, exiting fail-closed as UNVERIFIED ANSWER.
causes.type_solution: Enforced substantive verification gate (ADR-0013/0015) and added explicit EXECUTE/DRAFT_EXECUTION/EMIT_RESULT_IR python code block directives in ApiWorker ensuring solver script execution in ExecutionSandbox for 100% Arm 4 VERIFIED GREEN alignment.

causes.problem_statement: Upstream Groq engine rejected Pydantic schema with TransportError 400 ('Failed to validate JSON') due to $defs/$ref pointers and non-inlined object definitions.
causes.type_effect: API request failed on DRAFT_PLAN with upstream provider transport error.
causes.type_solution: Implemented full recursive $defs/$ref inlining, title/description purging, and strict additionalProperties:false enforcement in ApiWorker._sanitize_schema_for_grammar (ADR-0014 Pillar 4).

causes.problem_statement: _extract_data_payload regex missed variable assignment inputs (e.g., L = {71, 97, ...}), leaving SUPPLIED_EXECUTION_INPUT_SOURCE empty and causing model to claim unspecified list L. Additionally, problem_class regex partition\b missed partitioned, bypassing verified execution.
causes.type_effect: Model executed without input array and without verified execution sandbox mode, emitting ungrounded prose claims.
causes.type_solution: Updated _extract_data_payload regex to match variable assignments ([a-z0-9_-]+\s*[:=]\s*[\{\[\("'\d]) and updated problem_class/output_verifier regex to partitioned?\b to activate ExecutionSandbox verification.

causes.problem_statement: Model synthesized naive sequential backtracking (for i in range(start, len(triples))) without constraint propagation, exploring millions of states and exceeding the 5.0s ExecutionSandbox ceiling.
causes.type_effect: Execution timed out with empty stdout, returning no parsed witness and causing OutputVerifier to fail-closed as UNVERIFIED ANSWER.
causes.type_solution: Mandated Minimum Remaining Values (MRV) / most-constrained-element branch ordering in Plan Soundness Gate (ADR-0017) and calibrated sandbox timeout to 15.0s for verified execution.

causes.problem_statement: Model authored self-serving meta-rules in Prompt Pseudocode ('DO NOT perform the actual partitioning at this stage') and echoed them in execution to evade computation.
causes.type_effect: Model emitted zero code/deliverables and claimed green, defeating substantive correctness verification.
causes.type_solution: Enforced PROMPT-01 / PDL-08 prohibition against deferrals by automatically detecting and stripping/rejecting computation-evasion meta-rules in operation_bridge.py (ADR-0017).

causes.problem_statement: Pure unrouted gpt-oss-120b usage across all review gates caused 1.5s-3.0s review latencies, provider-side formatting crashes, and wire drops (missing_fields).
causes.type_effect: Session exited at non-terminal stage with exit code 2 (UNCONFIRMED_GATE) due to unrouted review wire failure.
causes.type_solution: Realigned runtime topology to wire Sys1Client (TypeSafe Jev) as the sovereign basis for activation and review gate transitions in <300ms (ADR-0012/ADR-0017).

causes.problem_statement: Substantive verification errors were misrouted to EMIT_RESULT_IR instead of code re-emission, while unverified runs erroneously transitioned to CLOSED_SUCCESS; Result IR section validator rejected standard generic aliases like 'code'.
causes.type_effect: Deliverable code could not be repaired via EMIT_RESULT_IR, and terminal failures falsely signalled success in the test runner.
causes.type_solution: Disrouted substantive verification errors to code-defect re-emission calling EXECUTE, grounded sandbox witness directly when python code is present, allowed standard code section aliases in Result IR, and enforced fail-closed termination (CLOSED_CANCELLED, exit code 1) on verification failure (ADR-0017).
